meta.source: Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT, as published by the RBI (DBIE, via the local Data Bank)
meta.product: Index of Eight Core Industries (RBI Handbook of Statistics, DBIE 499 and 989)
meta.revisionPolicy: The monthly index is provisional and revised in the next release; the RBI's annual tables carry the final financial-year averages.
meta.coverage: The composite index and its 8 industries on base 2011-12=100: financial-year average index and growth on a year earlier, as published
meta.note: Base 2011-12=100, a separate ruler from the other core-industry bases (never spliced). Index levels are financial-year averages; growth is the RBI's published growth on a year earlier, not recomputed. Weights are each industry's weight in the IIP of the same base; the composite's weight is the core industries' combined weight in the IIP.
